subject: Docs quickstart lead — scheduling a technical sandbox demo
messages:
From: Taylor Brooks <taylor@runframe.ai>
To: docs@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quickstart sign-up — interested in a technical demo

Hi Redwood team,

I just completed the docs quickstart and was able to prototype a small flow. Would love to book a short technical sandbox/demo to see how Redwood handles prefix caching and routing across our dev and staging clusters.

A little about us: RunFrame is building an assistant that aggregates telemetry from edge devices — low-latency inference is critical.

Thanks,
Taylor
Taylor Brooks
Head of Platform
RunFrame, Inc.
(t) 415-555-0198

Hi Taylor — welcome and thanks for trying the quickstart!

I’m Ava on the SDR team. Mateo (our platform engineer) and Dylan (solutions engineer) are copied — we typically run a 30–40 minute technical sandbox: short intro, a quick look at your quickstart output, and then a focused walkthrough of batching, caching, and routing recommendations.

Could you do any of these slots this week (PST)?
- Tue Sep 14, 10:00–10:40
- Tue Sep 14, 14:00–14:40
- Wed Sep 15, 09:00–09:40

If none work, send a few times that do and we’ll sync up. We’ll also share a short agenda and a calendar invite once we lock a time.

Best,
Ava Chen
Senior SDR, Developer Growth
Redwood Inference

Hi Ava — thanks for the quick reply. I can do Tue Sep 14 at 14:00 PST. A couple of quick asks before we meet:

1) Can you confirm whether the demo environment will include KV/prefix caching examples and whether we can share a brief sample payload ahead of time?
2) We have some basic compliance questions — does Redwood log token content by default in hosted demos, and can we get a pointer to the privacy/data retention notes?

If you can send an agenda and any pre-read, that would be great.

Thanks,
Taylor

Thanks Taylor — 14:00 PST works for us. I’ll send a calendar invite for a 30-minute slot and attach a short agenda and a sample pre-read.

Agenda (short):
- 5m intros and goals
- 10m quickstart artifacts + runframe payload review (please attach a small sample JSON if possible)
- 10m demo: prefix/KV cache behavior and routing policies (we’ll show both hosted and a dedicated-capacity profile)
- 5m next steps & blockers (probing for integration blockers, quantization questions)

Attaching: redwood-onramp-agenda.pdf (agenda + tech checklist) and a short screencap of our quickstart console for reference. Also attaching the calendar invite (tech-demo-invite.ics).

Short answers to your questions now:
- Demo environment: we’ll show prefix/KV caching in the hosted sandbox and describe how that maps to Dedicated; we can bring a sample payload into the session — please send a small JSON (no secrets) to this thread.
- Logs/retention: hosted demos do not persist token content outside of short-term debugging logs — we’ll forward the privacy notes after the meeting. For production we have KMS integrations and configurable retention.

See you Tue 14:00 PST.

—
Mateo Alvarez
Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference

(attachments: redwood-onramp-agenda.pdf, runframe-quickstart-screencap.png, tech-demo-invite.ics)
